messages:
olga: Quick postmortem follow-up for INC-2026-1304. We saw recurring latency spikes tied to KV cache invalidations during rolling deploys. Need temporary SLO change, owners, and a recurrence detection plan.
olga: Proposal: p95 latency SLO from 160ms -> 210ms for 28 days. Checkpoints at 72h and 14d. Early rollback if p95 < 170ms for 7 consecutive days.
anna (SRE): I support that window. Also recommend tightening the throughput evaluation window to 30s during the temp period so brief bursts don't burn error budget.
matt: I'll take the customer comms + SLA note. Will draft segmented notice and hold until 72h review unless user-facing regressions.
jyoti: I'll own dashboards and runbook. Plan: add p95, p99, QPS by pool, KV invalidation rate, and annotations for canary/incident windows.
jyoti: Sample PromQL I'll use for p95 by pool: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,pool))
slo-bot: Created incident follow-up INC-2026-1304-FU (#5330) and linked postmortem. Owners: anna,matt,jyoti,olga.
followup-bot: Reminder: oncall this week anna (SRE).
olga: Action items (please ack and link PR/ticket when done): - Dashboards + runbook (48h): jyoti - Canary + autoscaler smoothing (start in 4d): anna - Kernel perf probe (2w): anna - Customer comms draft (72h): matt - SLO governance update & rollback rules (5d): olga - Add monthly recurrence detection job (monthly): anna
anna (SRE): ack. I'll schedule the kernel probe and canary; canary abort if p99 > 450ms for 10m. Also adding automated fallback to safer model if p95 > 320ms for 10m.
matt: ack. Draft comms in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=inc5330-comms (private). Will request legal review after window locked.
jyoti: ack. Dashboard PR will include p99 panel and KV invalidation rate. PR link: https://git.redwood/dashboard/pull/1205 (stub).
olga: Timeline recap: dashboards + runbook 48h, canary in 4d, kernel probe 2w, 72h checkpoint then 14d review, 28d final debrief. If p95 returns <170ms for a week we revert earlier.
anna (SRE): adding a recurring tag to the incident so SRE cadence can search for similar patterns quarterly.
jyoti: done: PR opened and linked to #5330.
matt: done: comms draft linked and waiting on legal.
slo-bot: Follow-up checklist updated in #5330.
followup-bot: 72h checkpoint reminder set for 2723539989.
olga: Please drop a one-line "owned" when you've created PR/ticket links so I can finalize owners in the follow-up ticket. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
